facts.statement: Elrhazosaurus is a genus of basal iguanodontian dinosaur.
facts.quote: Elrhazosaurus (meaning "Elrhaz lizard") is a genus of basal iguanodontian dinosaur

facts.statement: Peter Galton and Philippe Taquet originally described the fossil as a new species of Valdosaurus in 1982.
facts.quote: The bone was designated as the type specimen of a new species of Valdosaurus (V. nigeriensis) by Peter Galton and Taquet in 1982

facts.statement: Peter Galton reclassified the species into its own genus, Elrhazosaurus, in 2009.
facts.quote: V. nigeriensis was given its own genus, Elrhazosaurus, by Galton in 2009

facts.statement: The dinosaur lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 115 million years ago during the Aptian, in what is now Africa.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 115 millones de años durante el Aptiense, en lo que es hoy África

facts.statement: The genus lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: As a dryosaurid iguanodontian, Elrhazosaurus was likely a lightly built, herbivorous, bipedal runner.
facts.quote: As a dryosaurid iguanodontian, Elrhazosaurus would have been a lightly built herbivorous bipedal runner

facts.statement: The dinosaur is classified within the family Dryosauridae.
Peter Galton retained the classification of Elrhazosaurus as a dryosaurid.
facts.quote: He retained it as a dryosaurid
